title: Abyssal razor

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
The Abyssal razor is the third knife. Its primary attack is a 3-hit attack combo with double damage on the last hit. Its secondary attack is a forward leap with 3x damage.
It deals 6x damage against enemies that have not been alerted.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: • Damage is equivalent to an iron tier weapon, without requiring any ore to craft.

Introduction. The Abyssal razor is the third knife. Its primary attack is a 3-hit attack combo with double damage on the last hit. Its secondary attack is a forward leap with 3x damage.
It deals 6x damage against enemies that have not been alerted.

Notes. • Damage is equivalent to an iron tier weapon, without requiring any ore to craft.
